entries.title: JWT alg:none Bypass
entries.summary: Forged an admin session by switching the JWT header alg to none and stripping the signature.
entries.learnings: Servers that blindly trust the alg field will accept unsigned tokens. Always check what libraries do when alg is set to none before trusting JWT validation. jwt_tool automates this with the -X a flag.

entries.title: RSA Common Modulus Attack
entries.summary: Two ciphertexts encrypted under the same modulus N with different public exponents let me recover the plaintext without factoring N.
entries.learnings: If gcd(e1, e2) = 1, the plaintext can be recovered via the extended Euclidean algorithm using m = c1^a * c2^b mod N. Reusing a modulus across keys is a critical RSA misconfiguration. Wrote a small Python + sympy script to automate this.

entries.title: Format String Leak to Bypass ASLR
entries.summary: Leaked a libc address through a printf format string bug, calculated the base, then built a ROP chain for a shell.
entries.learnings: Format string bugs are goldmines for info leaks even without direct write primitives. Used %p chains to walk the stack, matched the offset to a known libc address, then used one_gadget to find a shell-spawning offset once the base was known.

entries.title: Geolocating a Photo from Shadows and Signage
entries.summary: Located the exact intersection in a stripped-metadata photo using shadow angle estimation and a partially visible storefront sign.
entries.learnings: When EXIF data is scrubbed, shadows still encode time and latitude info (SunCalc helped narrow the capture window). Cross-referencing partial signage text with Google Maps Street View search closed the gap. Reverse image search alone was not enough here.
